name: Narwhal
lore: A Zenith that floats: the anti-ship rail laid down the keel of a long trimaran, so the sea can shoot back at the clouds. It carries nothing else, and dies to anything that reaches it on the water.

weapons.name: Zenith Rail Cannon
weapons.lore: The hull turns to aim and the barrel rises in its cradle; the breech swings down into a well in the deck.
